0022600144.text: The Hawks host the Cavaliers in Atlanta's sixth game of the season, with the Hawks at 2-3 on a three-game losing streak, 2nd in the Southeast and 1 game back, and 7th in the East, though they are 0-2 at home. Cleveland enters at 3-1 on a three-game winning streak, 2nd in the Central and 0.5 games back, 5th in the East, and perfect at 3-0 at home. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Cleveland's Jaylon Tyson (neck) and Meleek Thomas (foot) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Hawks won the last meeting 124-102 in Atlanta on April 10, 2026.
